lede: Wat Bun Yuen accounts for 22 catalogued manuscripts, 6 of them flagged research-priority. It clusters in Nan (95% of the corpus for this temple), ahead of Wiang Sa District. Nearly all (91%) are written in Tham Lanna · อักษรธรรมล้านนา script. By support it leans to palm-leaf · ใบลาน (95%) over mulberry paper (saa) · กระดาษสา (5%). Dated witnesses run 1578–1921 CE (6 of 22 carry a date).
